settings.text: What kind of products does Plantmade offer?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We offer a wide range of hair growth pro
settings.text: We offer a wide range of hair growth products such as hair oils, hair masks, shampoos, and conditioners. All our products are formulated with natural ingredients and are free from harmful chemicals like sulfates, parabens, and silicones.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Plantmade products vegan and cruelty-fre
Paragraphe · At Plantmade, we take pride in our commi
settings.text: At Plantmade, we take pride in our commitment to using only natural and plant-based ingredients. We believe that a healthy and sustainable lifestyle starts with the food we eat and the products that we use. That is why we are proud to say that all our products are 100% vegan and cruelty-free.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We know that our customers care about th
settings.text: We know that our customers care about the environment and the impact that their choices have on animals, which is why we are dedicated to creating products that are not only good for you, but also good for the planet. Our team of experts works tirelessly to ensure that we only use the highest quality ingredients, and that every product we make meets our strict standards for safety and effectiveness. Whether you are looking for skincare products, hair care products, or anything in between, you can trust Plantmade to deliver products that are good for you and good for the world around us.

settings.text: How long does it take to see results with Plantmade products?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Results vary from person to person, but
settings.text: Results vary from person to person, but most customers see an improvement in their hair growth within 4-6 weeks of using our products consistently. We recommend using our products for at least 3 months or 90 days to see significant results.
